title: FPicker: Topology-Guided Evolution for Filament Tracing in Low-SNR Microscopy
abstract: arXiv:2609.08305v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automating filament tracing in Cryo-Electron Microscopy (Cryo-EM) is essential for 3D helical reconstruction but challenged by intersecting topologies and extremely low Signal-to-Noise Ratios ($\text{SNR} = \sigma_s^2/\sigma_n^2$ < 0.1 or -10 dB). Existing paradigms fail: pixel-wise segmenters suffer from severe topological fracturing, box-based detectors face ghost center drift, sequential trackers derail due to error accumulation, and traditional active contours collapse under artificial closed-curve constraints. To resolve these bottlenecks, we present FPicker, the first topology-guided framework reconciling these incompatibilities. It unifies perception via a center-endpoint representation and an open-curve evolution module to explicitly model non-cyclic connectivity. translated_title: FPicker：面向低信噪比显微镜丝状追踪的拓扑引导演化方法
translated_abstract: 在冷冻电子显微镜（Cryo-EM）中实现丝状结构的自动追踪对于三维螺旋重建至关重要，但该任务面临拓扑交叉和极低信噪比（SNR = σs²/σn² < 0.1 或 -10 dB）的双重挑战。现有范式均无法胜任：逐像素分割方法存在严重的拓扑断裂问题，基于边界框的检测器面临幽灵中心漂移，序列式追踪器因误差累积而偏离轨道，传统活动轮廓方法则在人工闭合曲线约束下失效。为解决这些瓶颈，我们提出了FPicker，这是首个能够调和上述不兼容性的拓扑引导框架。该方法通过中心-端点表示与开放曲线演化模块实现感知的统一，从而显式地建模非循环的连通性。在模拟基准测试中，FPicker相比顶级基线方法在平均空间角度精度（mSAP）上取得了超过40%的相对提升，并显著降低了拓扑断口率。
tldr: FPicker是首个面向低信噪比冷冻电镜的拓扑引导丝状追踪框架，通过中心-端点表示与开放曲线演化模块显式建模非循环连通性，在mSAP指标上相对最优基线提升超过40%并大幅降低拓扑断口率。
en_tdlr: FPicker is the first topology-guided filament tracing framework for low-SNR cryo-EM, which unifies perception via center-endpoint representation and open-curve evolution to explicitly model non-cyclic connectivity, achieving over 40% relative mSAP gain over top baselines.
